name: ImmichKiosk
description: Immich Kiosk is a lightweight slideshow for running on kiosk devices and browsers that uses Immich as a data source.

paths.name: Config File
paths.description: Config file for application. Remove this if using environmental variables instead.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: The language code for Kiosk to use

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: The timezone for Kiosk to use

variables.name: Immich Api Key
variables.description: The API for your Immich server.

variables.name: Immich Url
variables.description: The URL of your Immich server. MUST include a port if one is needed e.g. `http://192.168.1.123:2283`.

variables.name: Immich External Url
variables.description: The public URL of your Immich server used for generating links and QR codes.

variables.name: Show Time
variables.description: Display clock.

variables.name: Time Format
variables.description: Display clock time in either 12-hour or 24-hour format. This can either be 12 or 24.

variables.name: Show Date
variables.description: Display the date.

variables.name: Date Format
variables.description: The format of the date. default is day/month/year.

variables.name: Clock Source
variables.description: The source of the clock. Either client or server.

variables.name: Duration
variables.description: The amount in seconds an image will be displayed for.

variables.name: Disable Screensaver
variables.description: Ask browser to request a lock that prevents device screens from dimming or locking. NOTE: I haven't been able to get this to work consistently on IOS.

variables.name: Optimize Images
variables.description: Whether Kiosk should resize images to match your browser screen dimensions for better performance. NOTE: In most cases this is not necessary, but if you are accessing Kiosk on a low-powered device, this may help.

variables.name: Use Gpu
variables.description: Enable GPU acceleration for improved performance (e.g., CSS transforms)

variables.name: Show Archived
variables.description: Allow assets marked as archived to be displayed.

variables.name: Albums
variables.description: The ID(s) of one or more albums to display.

variables.name: Album Order
variables.description: The order an album's assets will be displayed.

variables.name: Excluded Albums
variables.description: The ID(s) of a specific album or albums you want to exclude.

variables.name: Show Videos
variables.description: Enable video playback.

variables.name: Live Photos
variables.description: Enable live photos playback for albums.

variables.name: Live Photo Loop Delay
variables.description: Delay in seconds before looping live photos.

variables.name: People
variables.description: The ID(s) of a specific person or people you want to display.

variables.name: Require All People
variables.description: Require all people to be present in an asset.

variables.name: Excluded People
variables.description: The ID(s) of a specific person or people you want to exclude.

variables.name: Dates
variables.description: A date range or ranges.

variables.name: Tags
variables.description: Tag or tags you want to display.

variables.name: Excluded Tags
variables.description: The tag or tags you want to exclude.

variables.name: Memories
variables.description: Display memories.

variables.name: Blacklist
variables.description: The ID(s) of any specific assets you want Kiosk to skip/exclude from displaying.

variables.name: Date Filter
variables.description: Filter person and random assets by date.

variables.name: Disable Navigation
variables.description: Disable all Kiosk's navigation (touch/click, keyboard and menu).

variables.name: Disable Ui
variables.description: A shortcut to set show_time, show_date, show_image_time and show_image_date to false.

variables.name: Menu Position
variables.description: Sets the position of the menu bar.

variables.name: Frameless
variables.description: Remove borders and rounded corners on images.

variables.name: Hide Cursor
variables.description: Hide cursor/mouse via CSS.

variables.name: Font Size
variables.description: The base font size for Kiosk. Default is 100% (16px). DO NOT include the % character.

variables.name: Background Blur
variables.description: Display a blurred version of the image as a background.

variables.name: Background Blur Amount
variables.description: The amount of blur to apply to the background image (sigma).

variables.name: Theme
variables.description: Which theme to use.

variables.name: Layout
variables.description: Which layout to use.

variables.name: Sleep Start
variables.description: Time (in 24hr format) to start sleep mode.

variables.name: Sleep End
variables.description: Time (in 24hr format) to end sleep mode.

variables.name: Sleep Icon
variables.description: Display icon during sleep mode.

variables.name: Sleep Dim Screen
variables.description: Dim screen during sleep mode when using Fully Kiosk Browser.

variables.name: Transition
variables.description: Which transition to use when changing images.

variables.name: Fade Transition Duration
variables.description: The duration of the fade (in seconds) transition.

variables.name: Cross Fade Transition Duration
variables.description: The duration of the cross-fade (in seconds) transition.

variables.name: Show Progress Bar
variables.description: Display a progress bar for when image will refresh.

variables.name: Progress Bar Position
variables.description: Sets the position of the progress bar.

variables.name: Image Fit
variables.description: How the image should fit on the screen. Default is "contain".

variables.name: Image Effect
variables.description: Add an effect to images.

variables.name: Image Effect Amount
variables.description: Set the intensity of the image effect. Use a number between 100 (minimum) and higher, without the % symbol.

variables.name: Use Original Image
variables.description: Use the original image. NOTE: If the original is not a png, gif, jpeg or webp Kiosk will fall back to using the preview.

variables.name: Show Owner
variables.description: Display the asset owner. Useful for shared albums.

variables.name: Show Album Name
variables.description: Display album names that the asset appears in.

variables.name: Show Person Name
variables.description: Display people's names.

variables.name: Show Person Age
variables.description: Display people's ages.

variables.name: Show Image Time
variables.description: Display image time from METADATA (if available).

variables.name: Image Time Format
variables.description: Display image time in either 12-hour or 24-hour format. This can either be 12 or 24.

variables.name: Show Image Date
variables.description: Display the image date from METADATA (if available).

variables.name: Image Date Format
variables.description: The format of the image date. default is day/month/year.

variables.name: Show Image Description
variables.description: Display image description from METADATA (if available).

variables.name: Show Image Exif
variables.description: Display image Fnumber, Shutter speed, focal length, ISO from METADATA (if available).

variables.name: Show Image Location
variables.description: Display the image location from METADATA (if available).

variables.name: Show Image Qr
variables.description: Displays a QR code linking to the original image (in Immich) next to the image metadata.

variables.name: Hide Countries
variables.description: List of countries to hide from image_location

variables.name: Show More Info
variables.description: Enables the display of additional information about the current image(s)

variables.name: Show More Info Image Link
variables.description: Shows a link to the original image (in Immich) in the additional information overlay

variables.name: Show More Info Qr Code
variables.description: Displays a QR code linking to the original image (in Immich) in the additional information overlay

variables.name: Like Button Action
variables.description: Action(s) to perform when the like button is clicked. Supported actions are [favorite, album].

variables.name: Hide Button Action
variables.description: Action(s) to perform when the hide button is clicked. Supported actions are [tag, archive].

variables.name: Show User
variables.description: Display the user used to fetch the image.

variables.name: Use Offline Mode
variables.description: Enable offline mode for the device.

variables.name: Iframe
variables.description: Add iframes into Kiosk.

variables.name: Config Validation Level
variables.description: The level of validation to perform on the config.yaml file.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Which port Kiosk should use. NOTE: This is only typically needed when running Kiosk outside of a container. If you are running inside a container the port will need to be reflected in your compose file, e.g. `HOST_PORT:KIOSK_PORT`

variables.name: Behind Proxy
variables.description: Is Kiosk running behind a proxy?

variables.name: Watch Config
variables.description: Should Kiosk watch config.yaml file for changes. Reloads all connect clients if a change is detected.

variables.name: Fetched Assets Size
variables.description: The number of assets (data) requested from Immich per api call. min=1 max=1000.

variables.name: Http Timeout
variables.description: The number of seconds before an http request will time out.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Please see FAQs for more info. If set, requests MUST contain the password in the GET parameters, e.g. `http://192.168.0.123:3000?password=PASSWORD`.

variables.name: Cache
variables.description: Cache selective Immich api calls to reduce unnecessary calls.

variables.name: Prefetch
variables.description: Pre-fetch assets in the background, so images load much quicker when duration timer ends.

variables.name: Asset Weighting
variables.description: Balances asset selection when multiple sources are used, e.g. multiple people and albums. When enabled, sources with fewer assets will show less often.
